    (3, 1): 1000, (3, 2): 2000, (3, 3): 1500, (3, 4): 2500
}

a = {1: 2, 2: 4, 3: 3}
C = 15000
p = {1: 20, 2: 20, 3: 10}
h = 5

# Problem
prob = pulp.LpProblem("Production_Planning", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("x", [(i, t) for i in products for t in periods], lowBound=0)
I = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("I", [(i, t) for i in products for t in periods], lowBound=0)
B = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("B", [(i, t) for i in products for t in periods], lowBound=0)

# Objective
prob += pulp.lpSum(p[i] * B[(i, t)] for i in products for t in periods) + pulp.lpSum(h * I[(i, t)] for i in products for t in periods)

# Constraints
# 1. Inventory balance
for i in products:
    for t in periods:
        prob += x[(i, t)] + (I[(i, t-1)] if t > 1 else 0) + B[(i, t)] == d[(i, t)] + I[(i, t)] + (B[(i, t-1)] if t > 1 else 0), f"InventoryBalance_{i}_{t}"

    prob += a[1] * x[(1, t)] + a[2] * x[(2, t)] + a[3] * x[(3, t)] <= C, f"Capacity_{t}"

# Problem
prob = pulp.LpProblem("Aggregate_Production_Planning", pulp.LpMaximize)

# Variables
t = range(1, 7)
W = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("W", t, lowBound=0, cat=pulp.LpInteger)
H = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("H", t, lowBound=0)
L = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("L", t, lowBound=0)
P = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("P", t, lowBound=0)
O = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("O", t, lowBound=0)
I = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("I", [0] + list(t), lowBound=0)

# Objective
prob += revenue - pulp.lpSum(5 * O[t] + 10 * I[t] + 500 * H[t] + 700 * L[t] for t in t)

# Constraints
for t_val in t:
    # Workforce balance
    if t_val == 1:
        prob += W[t_val] == W0 + H[t_val] - L[t_val]
    else:
        prob += W[t_val] == W[t_val - 1] + H[t_val] - L[t_val]

    # Workforce change limit
    prob += H[t_val] <= 5
    prob += L[t_val] <= 5

    # Regular production
    prob += P[t_val] == 20 * W[t_val]

    # Overtime capacity
    prob += O[t_val] <= 6 * W[t_val]

    # Inventory balance
    prob += I[t_val - 1] + P[t_val] + O[t_val] == d[t_val - 1] + I[t_val]

# Final inventory
prob += I[6] == 0

# Solve
prob.solve(pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=False, timeLimit=60))

# Output
print(f"STATUS={pulp.LpStatus[prob.status]} OBJECTIVE={pulp.value(prob.objective)}")
